items: LAGOS STATE (PSI 9.2): Signs Tripartite Okobaba Sawmill Regeneration Pact (Laguna Park), Resolves 29,801 CMB Disputes (₦943.89M) & Champions PPP Execution
EBONYI STATE (PSI 9.0): Approves 933.78-Hectare FON Smart City & 3.3km River Dredging in Abakaliki, Bankrolls Free Cataract Surgeries for 400+ Patients
GOMBE STATE (PSI 8.6): Commissions 30 Gombe Line Buses (110 Total) with EV/CNG Transition Plan, Deploys Federal Fire Service to Dukku & Empowers 150 Women
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 8.3): Distributes 2,080 Vehicles in Phase II Youth Empowerment & Suspends Maru Campaign Following Fatal Gummi Road Accident
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 8.1): Launches 2027–2031 Demographic Dividend Roadmap & Assesses Ganye LGA Roads Alongside 5km Jada Township Asphalt Work
KANO STATE (PSI 7.9): Flags Off Distribution of Tricycle Ambulances Across All 484 Wards in 44 Local Government Areas
EDO STATE (PSI 7.6): EDOHERMA Mandates Approved Channels for 2027 Health Facility Licence Renewals & Explores Joint Enforcement with CPC
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 7.4): Conducts Joint UNDP Technical Assessment of Mangu Widowhood Centre Under ISSP & Honours PRUWASSA Leadership
EKITI STATE (PSI 7.2): Highlights Over 5,000 Youths Engaged in Bring Back Youth into Agriculture Programme Driving Farm Cluster Profits
DELTA STATE (PSI 7.1): Gov. Oborevwori Imposes 6pm–6am Curfew Across Ughelli North LGA & Orders Probe Following Uduere Killings
ENUGU STATE (PSI 7.0): Gov. Mbah Advances Upgrade of Nnamdi Azikiwe Stadium to FIFA Standards with VAR & Olympic Swimming Pool
AKWA IBOM STATE (PSI 6.7): Gov. Eno Receives Police Peace & Security Award; Announces Nov 24–27 Unity Park Maintenance Ahead of Christmas Unplugged 4.0
NIGER STATE (PSI 6.2): Gov. Bago Commiserates with State Judiciary Over Demise of Former Chief Judge Justice Muhammad Aliyu Mayaki

LAGOS (PSI 9.2): Gov. Babajide Sanwo-Olu signed a tripartite agreement with TAJ Bank Limited and Berkly Facilities Services Limited to regenerate the 32-hectare decommissioned Okobaba Sawmill site in Ebute Metta into Laguna Park after relocating timber workers to Timberville, Agbowa-Ikosi (with 300 free housing units); the Citizens' Mediation Bureau reported resolving 29,801 disputes and recovering ₦943.89m between January and October 2026; and OPPP Special Adviser Mrs. Bukola Odoe advocated institutional MoU ownership at the Lagos Employment Summit 4.0.

EBONYI (PSI 9.0): Gov. Francis Nwifuru's State Executive Council approved the designation of 933.777 hectares of former Army land in Abakaliki as FON Smart City alongside dredging 3,305.61 metres of the Ebonyi River for flood mitigation, while the state government partnered with AEFUTHA and Albasar International Foundation to deliver over 400 free phacoemulsification cataract surgeries and postoperative medications.

GOMBE (PSI 8.6): Gov. Muhammadu Inuwa Yahaya commissioned 30 new Gombe Line buses (bringing total fleet additions since 2019 to 110) and announced plans for electric and CNG-powered buses with a Mega Park CNG refuelling station; the Federal Fire Service officially deployed personnel to Dukku LGA; and the Gombe Charity and Empowerment Initiative empowered 150 women.

ZAMFARA (PSI 8.3): Gov. Dauda Lawal flagged off Phase II of the ZAPA empowerment programme in Gusau distributing 2,080 vehicles (1,000 motorcycles, 1,000 tricycles, 40 high-jet pickups, and 40 three-wheeled pickups) to youths, while suspending scheduled campaign activities in Maru LGA following a fatal road accident involving Gummi APC members that claimed over ten lives.

ADAMAWA (PSI 8.1): Gov. Ahmadu Umaru Fintiri, represented by Deputy Gov. Prof. Kaletapwa Farauta, unveiled Adamawa's 2027–2031 Roadmap for Harnessing Demographic Dividend anchored on health, education, entrepreneurship, and governance, while Works Commissioner Hon. Mohammed Suleiman assessed four proposed roads in Ganye LGA and inspected ongoing asphalt work on the 5km Jada Township Road.

KANO (PSI 7.9): The Kano State Government, through the Ministry of Health, held the official flag-off ceremony at Sani Abacha Indoor Stadium to distribute tricycle ambulances across all 484 political wards in the state's 44 LGAs.

EDO (PSI 7.6): Edo State Healthcare Regulation and Monitoring Agency (EDOHERMA) CEO Dr. Adesuwa Urhoghide-Edigin directed all public and private health facilities to pay 2027 licence renewal fees strictly through official EDOHERMA channels and initiated collaboration with the Edo State Consumer Protection Committee (CPC) on patient safety, fake-drug referrals, and NAPAMS training.

PLATEAU (PSI 7.4): Plateau State officials and UNDP engineers conducted a joint technical assessment of the Mangu Widowhood Centre under the Integrated Smart and Sustainable State Programme (ISSP) ahead of hostel, staff quarters, and solar upgrades, while PRUWASSA honoured GM Engr. Godfrey Dashuhar and three directors for rural water and sanitation delivery.

EKITI (PSI 7.2): Gov. Biodun Oyebanji's administration highlighted milestones under the Bring Back Youth into Agriculture programme, which has integrated over 5,000 youths into revived farm settlements with land clearing, subsidised tractors, and processing support, generating hundreds of millions of naira in cluster profits and helping curb food inflation.

DELTA (PSI 7.1): Gov. Sheriff Oborevwori condemned deadly violence in Uduere community, Ughelli North LGA, imposed an immediate daily 6:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. curfew across the entire local government area, and directed security agencies to arrest and prosecute all perpetrators and sponsors.

ENUGU (PSI 7.0): Gov. Peter Mbah's administration continued major reconstruction works to upgrade Nnamdi Azikiwe Stadium, Enugu, to FIFA standards featuring Video Assistant Referee (VAR) systems, Command and Control facilities, and an Olympic-standard swimming pool.

AKWA IBOM (PSI 6.7): Gov. Umo Eno received an Excellence Award in Peace and Security Management from the Nigeria Police Force, Akwa Ibom State Command, while Information Commissioner Hon. Aniekan Umanah announced a temporary November 24–27 restriction at Unity Park, Uyo, for sanitation and polishing ahead of Christmas Unplugged 4.0.

NIGER (PSI 6.2): Gov. Mohammed Umaru Bago issued an official condolence message to Chief Judge Justice Halima Ibrahim Abdulmalik, the Niger State Judiciary, and the Mayaki family following the passing of former Chief Judge Justice Muhammad Aliyu Mayaki.
